rationale: Gold that closes above the 01:00 open plus a band of normal daily noise, with VWAP on the same side, tends to keep going while midday liquidity is thin. Losing side: Traders who sell the push expecting gold to fall back inside the usual daily range.
notes: noise_band: a bar closes beyond open +/- k x A (A = the daily ATR(14) of the days before) and the anchored VWAP -> market entry at the next bar's open. rth = 09:30 ET open and VWAP; globex = 01:00 ET open (midnight Central) and VWAP. The band is fixed for the day; entries inside the idea's session, up to max_tr a session, one position at a time; flat 15:58. Conti's vault break averages 15 sessions; here A is the toolkit's daily ATR(14), the source gap uses
note: idea gc_noise_mid_long_early: the locked variants on the test days, session mid
